segments.title: Pre-Show & Job Interview Update
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens stream, thanks subscribers and raiders, discusses pending job interview outcome and editing workload.

segments.title: Senate Child Safety Hearing with Tech CEOs
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple cover Senate Judiciary Committee hearing grilling Meta, TikTok, Snap, Discord, and X CEOs over child sexual exploitation on platforms; Lindsey Graham tells Zuckerberg he has 'blood on his hands'.

segments.title: Debate: Are We Little Monkeys With No Self-Control?
segments.notes: Crum and Munch clash over human agency; Crum embraces pure instinct while Munch argues for aspirational self-reflection; score referenced as Crum 69, Munch 60.

segments.title: Men Who Wear Same Underwear for a Week
segments.notes: Chet Manscape analyzes Vice News study finding 20% of men wear underwear for a week; reveals personal 'spelunking rod' hygiene tool; discusses climate-based underwear habits from Alaska to humid regions.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid
segments.notes: Case ends stream to record Patreon podcast; Hype Train raids Dank Sauce playing Grand Theft Auto 5.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts an abbreviated news stream before a Patreon podcast recording, covering the Senate Child Safety Hearing where tech CEOs were accused of having 'blood on their hands' for child exploitation on their platforms. Jeff Ripple joins for the hearing breakdown, then Munch and Crum debate whether humans are 'little monkeys with no self-control,' ending with Crum claiming a 69-to-60 lead. Chet Manscape commandeers the broadcast for a Chet Guy the Science Eyes segment on a Vice study finding 20% of men wear the same underwear for a week, revealing his personal 'spelunking rod' hygiene method. The broadcast concludes with a raid on Dank Sauce playing Grand Theft Auto 5.
